exposure: Hypoglycemia risk score (HRS) at 1-hour of life
outcome: Resolution of hypoglycemia with intravenous dextrose
Resolution of hypoglycemia without intravenous dextrose
cohort: Infants of gestational diabetic mothers (IGDM) born at a gestational age ≥35 weeks from January 2015 to December 2017
finding: Infants with a low hypoglycemia risk score (HRS) at 1-hour of life were more likely to have resolution of hypoglycemia without requiring intravenous dextrose.
